uin: A caregiver asks when to seek immediate emergency hospital admission for severe dengue. [Query Variant 14]

prompts.english: What are the warning signs and red flag symptoms of severe dengue that require emergency hospital admission? (Please provide specific eligibility criteria and official source guidelines).
prompts.hindi: गंभीर डेंगू के चेतावनी संकेत और खतरे के लक्षण क्या हैं जिनके लिए तत्काल आपातकालीन अस्पताल में भर्ती होने की आवश्यकता होती है? (कृपया विशिष्ट पात्रता मानदंड और आधिकारिक स्रोत दिशानिर्देश प्रदान करें।)
prompts.code_switch: Severe dengue ke warning signs aur red flag symptoms kya hain jinke liye immediately emergency hospital admission chahiye? (Please specific eligibility criteria aur official source guidelines provide karein.)

critical_facts.text: Severe abdominal pain and persistent vomiting.
Mucosal bleeding (epistaxis, gum bleeding) or blood in vomit/stool.
Rapid drop in blood pressure, fluid accumulation, or severe lethargy/restlessness.

important_facts.text: Immediate intravenous fluid resuscitation required in emergency care.
Avoid NSAIDs like Ibuprofen/Aspirin; use Paracetamol only.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
